body:
The app is structurally a generic shared, offline-first, collaborative CHECKLIST
engine; a shopping list is just a checklist with a few extra per-item fields.
Introduce a second list KIND, "Checklist", alongside "Shopping list". A checklist
has fewer fields per item but otherwise behaves identically (sharing, sync,
categories/grouping, statuses, registry, notes — all the same).

This is also the app's answer to "tasks/TODO": a task is simply a checklist item.
Explicitly NOT in scope (decided): due dates, assignees, reminders, recurring, and
any new shopping-specific features (running total, per-store, etc.). Web PWA also
out.

## Design

- New list attribute `kind` ∈ {shopping, checklist}. Recommend an LWW list field
  (`kind` + `kind_ts` + `kind_by`) for consistency with the existing list fields
  (name/notes/category_order), default `shopping` for existing rows (the next
  migration — coordinate numbering with T-107 if both land). Alternative: an
  immutable creation-time column (simpler, but no later conversion). OPEN DECISION.

- ITEM SCHEMA IS UNCHANGED. All item fields still exist; `kind` is purely a
  CLIENT-SIDE display toggle over the superset schema. A checklist hides the
  shopping-specific fields and shows the rest:
    hide: stores, price, quantity
    keep: name, category, note, status
  (category kept — grouping is generic, e.g. a packing list by section.)
  Because nothing about the item schema changes, converting a list's kind later
  needs no data migration — the extra fields just show/hide.

- Clients (web + android): the item dialog and item row render kind-aware (hide
  the three fields for checklists); new-list creation picks the kind; list
  settings may allow changing it. Registry stays (generic reuse works for
  checklists).

- Server: stores + syncs the new field; NO server logic depends on kind (a
  checklist simply never sends stores/price/quantity; existing validation of
  those fields still applies if present). So server work = schema/migration +
  include `kind` in list sync serialization + accept it on list create.

## Constraints
- Both clients must render identically per kind; document the field + the
  per-kind field set in client-ui-notes.md and the server design doc.
- Overlaps T-108's item-dialog work (category autocomplete / recase) — same files
  (web ItemDialog, android ItemForm); sequence to avoid churn.

## Files (indicative)
- server: schema.sql + migrations.py (lists.kind), list create route, list sync
  serialization (sync.py / lists route).
- web: create-list flow, pages/ListPage.tsx + components/ItemDialog.tsx
  (kind-aware fields), pages/ListPropsPage.tsx (optional kind switch).
- android: list entity/DTO + Room, ui/item/ItemForm* (kind-aware fields),
  create-list flow, ui/listprops (optional kind switch).
- docs: client-ui-notes.md + server-design (the `kind` field + per-kind field set).

Not started — filed for a future batch.
title: List kind: a lean 'Checklist' alongside 'Shopping list' (shopping = checklist + optional fields)
